## Deviations from the skill defaults

All are recorded in `.claude/rules/openapi.md` § Project overrides, so they count as deviations under a team rule, not open items.

| Default | This contract | Backed by |
|---|---|---|
| A REST endpoint per user story | Server actions in `server-actions.md`; OpenAPI only for the webhook and cron jobs | ADR-0003; user decision 2026-10-30 |
| `/api/v1/...` | `/api/billing/...`, `/api/jobs/...` | Existing routes (`/api/apiary/upload`, `/api/auth`); the webhook URL is registered with Monobank |
| Global `BearerAuth` | `CronSecret` (bearer) for jobs, `MonobankSignature` (`X-Sign`) for the webhook | sad.md §8 Webhook trust, Job trust |
| Error `code` `module.error_name` everywhere | Kept for route handlers; server actions use the repo's `formError` / `fieldErrors` keys | `src/modules/apiary/add-hive.action.ts`, `messages/*.json` |
| Events `module.action.vN` | `src/shared/events` shape (`PaymentSucceeded`, `payload`, `occurredAt`) plus the outbox `id` | `src/shared/events/index.ts`, ADR-0005 |
| `Idempotency-Key` on a retried mutating endpoint | None on the webhook: Monobank sends no such header. Apply-once on `invoiceId` + `modifiedDate` instead | `.claude/rules/billing.md`, sad.md §8 Idempotency |
| Cursor pagination on lists | No paginated lists. Every list has tens to hundreds of rows (sad.md §7 scaling) and is read by a server component | sad.md §7 |
| snake_case JSON keys | Monobank's camelCase in `MonobankInvoiceStatus`; our own response `ended_count` stays snake_case | External payload |

## Section B — drift findings

1. **Endpoint ↔ data-model** *(core)* — ✓. Each operation reads or writes a data-model entity: the webhook writes Payment, PaymentAuditEntry, CheckoutHold, Subscription and OutboxEvent; reconcile-payments the same; season-end writes Subscription and OutboxEvent; the outbox sweep writes OutboxEvent and ProcessedEvent. Every server action and read function names its table in `server-actions.md`.
2. **Error code ↔ repo error definition** *(core)* — ✓ (deferred: the registry does not exist yet). The repo keeps error keys in `src/modules/<module>/messages/{uk,en}.json` under `errors`. `billing` has no messages file yet, so the 20 `billing.*` keys and the route-handler codes (`billing.invalid_signature`, `billing.invalid_webhook_body`, `jobs.unauthorized`, `jobs.run_failed`) are this contract's proposal; implement-tasks creates them. The three `apiary.*` keys reused by `setSeasonAction` already exist in `src/modules/apiary/messages/en.json`.
3. **Validation ↔ constraint** *(core)* — ✓. `name` 1–100 = `VARCHAR(100)`; `nickname` 1–40 = `VARCHAR(40)` and AC-21; `invoiceId` `maxLength: 64` = `VARCHAR(64)` (its own TBD stays in data-model.md:195); price above 0 and quota 0 or more = AC-02, enforced in code because the DB has no `CHECK`; season dates = AC-07; status values = the app-side unions in data-model.md. No conflict between PRD and model.
4. **Entity / AC ↔ endpoint (coverage)** *(supporting)* — ✓.
   - Entities: Plan, Season, CheckoutHold, Payment, Subscription are surfaced. Intentionally internal: PaymentAuditEntry (audit trail; read only for `PaymentWithoutRental.paidAt`), OutboxEvent and ProcessedEvent (delivery infrastructure, ADR-0005), `Hive.rentedSubscriptionId` (written only by the apiary event handler, displayed nowhere, ADR-0004).
   - ACs: AC-01–AC-05 → createPlan, archivePlan, listPlans; AC-06–AC-09 → setSeason, getApiarySeason; AC-10–AC-14 → getHiveRentalStatuses, startCheckout; AC-15–AC-17 → webhook, getHoldStatus, events `PaymentSucceeded`; AC-18–AC-19b → webhook, retryPayment, getHoldStatus, reconcile-payments, listPaymentsWithoutRental; AC-20–AC-22 → setNickname, getClientRentals; AC-23 → getHiveRentalStatuses; AC-24–AC-25 → getBeekeeperSeasons; AC-26 → getHiveRentalStatuses, getClientRentals, season-end, `SubscriptionEnded`; AC-27–AC-28 → clearNickname, getClientRentals. Every AC has at least one operation.
   - Every operation maps to a §4 user story (listed per function in `server-actions.md`; the jobs serve US-04, US-05 and US-09).
5. **OpenAPI ↔ sequence** *(supporting)* — ✓ (deferred: 6 sequence gaps). Every `alt` branch in flows 1–14 has a response, state variant or error key. The reverse direction found six responses the contract needs that no flow or AC shows; the user chose to fix the contract and defer the source (Deferrals 1–6).

## Section D — Deferrals

| # | What | Why parked | Next step |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `startCheckout` for a hive that does not exist → `billing.hiveNotFound` | Flow 8 has no hive-missing branch; the contract answers it like the repo's other "not found" cases | Add the branch with `/sdlc:complete-sequence-diagrams hive-rental --flow 8` |
| 2 | `retryPayment` for an unknown or another client's hold → `billing.holdNotFound` | Flow 10 starts from the client's own hold; existence hiding per sad.md §8 | Add the branch to flow 10 |
| 3 | `retryPayment` when Monobank is unavailable → `billing.paymentUnavailable`, hold keeps running | Flow 10 has no provider-error branch (flow 8 does) | Add the branch to flow 10 |
| 4 | `archivePlan` for an unknown plan → `billing.planNotFound` | Flow 5 starts from an existing plan | Add the branch to flow 5 |
| 5 | Webhook with a valid signature and an unknown `invoiceId` → 200 and an alert-level log | Flow 9 assumes the payment exists; 200 stops Monobank from resending a body we can never apply | Add the branch to flow 9 |
| 6 | `SubscriptionActivated` (bc-map: billing → scheduling) is not published in v1 | No §6 flow publishes it and `scheduling` has no code | Mark it "not published yet" in `docs/bc-map.md`, or add it to flow 9 when `scheduling` needs it; owner ivan lysakov, before the scheduling PRD |
| 7 | `billing.*` error keys and route-handler codes have no registry entry yet | `src/modules/billing/messages/` does not exist | implement-tasks creates `messages/{uk,en}.json` with every key in `server-actions.md` § Error keys |
| 8 | Monobank webhook field names and `status` values come from Monobank's acquiring docs, not from a real test payload | PRD §8 and sad.md §11: test access is unproven | Confirm against the first test payment in the first build slice, then `--reconcile` |

Deferrals 1–5 can be closed in one `/sdlc:complete-sequence-diagrams hive-rental` pass, then `/sdlc:api-forge hive-rental --reconcile`.
